subject: chemistry
content: A solid mixture (5.0 g) consisting of lead nitrate and sodium nitrate was headed below 600<sup>o</sup>C until the weight of the residue was constant. If the loss in weight 28.0 percent, find the amount of lead nitrate and sodium nitrate in the mixture.
